LanguageData.Gun_TT-33_RWP.description: The TT-33 is a semi-automatic pistol, known for its reliability and historical significance. Developed in the early 20th century, it offers moderate damage with a high fire rate, making it effective for defense in close-quarters combat. Though its accuracy falls off at longer ranges, its craftsmanship ensures durability in harsh conditions.
